data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 81.9m (2015: GBP 48.0m) is a deterioration of GBP 10.9m (2015: improvement of GBP 0.2m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to the unfavourable development of Property, Political Risks and European Creditor business.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse development on prior years in the Political Risks class due to a number of large notifications in relation to the credit book impacting single premium exposures on prior years of account.
Higher than expected attritional development in the legacy European Creditor business.
An unfavourable settlement on a long-standing Property claim resulted in adverse development on prior years.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced adverse prior-year reserve development in 2016 with a deterioration of GBP 10.9m (net) to claims reserves established at the prior year end. The movement was principally driven by adverse development in Property, Political Risks and legacy European Creditor (Credit & Suretyship/Consumer Products) business. This reserve strengthening materially contributed to higher net claims incurred for the year.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior-year development figure used is taken from the notes as an explicitly stated deterioration of GBP 10.9m but is described in the text as included within 'net claims incurred' (i.e. net of reinsurance). No explicit gross (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement line was provided; a gross claims development triangle exists but is impacted by reinsurance-to-close and prior-year reinsurances (RITC) in the period which can distort a triangle-based PYD calculation. Opening gross claims outstanding used the Balance Sheet prior-year column. Where gross amounts were not available per event/LOB, amounts are left null.
